name: sim_weyl_b2_sp4_coupling
description: W(B2) Weyl group coupled to Sp(4) Lie algebra; B2 root system {8 roots} verified as sp(4) roots; symplectic condition checked; W(B2)=D4 order 8; double Dynkin bond distinguishes B2 from A2; B2=C2 duality confirmed

pytorch.reason: Verify symplectic condition M^T J M = J for Sp(4) root-space generators; W(B2) signed permutation matrices act on B2 root vectors and stay in root system; compute gram matrix of all 8 B2 roots to verify root system closure

pyg.reason: no graph learning required; probe operates on density matrices not graph structures

z3.reason: UNSAT: a W(B2) reflection maps a root to a vector that is NOT in the B2 root system — structurally impossible since reflections by definition preserve the root system; z3 encodes root membership as disjunction and proves the negation is unsatisfiable

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for root-system membership UNSAT; cvc5 deferred

sympy.reason: Symbolic verification that B2 root system {±e1, ±e2, ±e1±e2} equals the roots of sp(4) exactly; symplectic Lie bracket [X,Y] in sp(4) checks root space decomposition; sp(4) dimension = 10 confirmed

clifford.reason: B2 root vectors in Cl(4,0) as grade-1 multivectors; W(B2) reflections as Clifford sandwich products preserve grade-1 structure; symplectic form J encoded as grade-2 bivector e1^e3 + e2^e4; B2 reflections preserve it

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: B2 Dynkin diagram: 2-node graph with edge weight 2 (double bond); W(B2) Cayley graph: 8 nodes (dihedral D4 order 8); verify both graph structures and that B2 double bond distinguishes it from A2 (single bond)

xgi.reason: 3-way hyperedge {B2_root_system, sp4_Lie_algebra, W_B2_Weyl_group} encodes the irreducible triadic correspondence; each pairwise link is a strict structural identity, not just isomorphism

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: no persistent homology or Rips complex computation required in this probe

z3_reflection_preserves_b2_roots.claim: W(B2) reflection of a B2 root leaves B2 root system
z3_reflection_preserves_b2_roots.explanation: Swap (r1,r2)->(r2,r1) of any B2 root stays in B2; UNSAT

z3_s2_reflection_preserves_b2_roots.claim: W(B2) reflection by alpha2 of a B2 root stays in B2
z3_s2_reflection_preserves_b2_roots.explanation: Negate r2: (r1,-r2) of any B2 root stays in B2; UNSAT

sympy_b2_c2_duality.note: B2 and C2 are dual (transpose Cartan matrices) hence same Weyl group
